name: claude-limits
description: Floating panel showing how much of your Claude plan limits you have used. Starts with Claude Desktop.
long_description: Shows plan usage (5-hour and 7-day windows, plus per-model windows when the app records them) as a small always-on-top panel pinned to the corner of the Claude Desktop window. It appears when the app starts and closes with it. Four looks: card, compact, bar and icon. Data is read locally from the usage cache Claude Desktop writes on this machine; nothing is sent anywhere. Chat tools (show_limits, get_limits) are available as a fallback.

tools.name: show_limits
tools.description: Show a panel with current Claude plan usage in the chat.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Return current Claude plan usage as text and JSON.

tools.name: overlay_status
tools.description: Report whether the floating panel is running, and why it is not.

tools.name: overlay_restart
tools.description: Restart the floating panel, or close it with off: true.

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: Report which local data sources and desktop environment were found.

overlay.title: Floating panel on startup
overlay.description: Show the panel in the corner of the Claude Desktop window as soon as the app starts.

python.title: Path to python3 (optional)
python.description: Set this if GTK is installed for a different python3 than the first one found.
